NHIA KNOWLEDGE BASE

SOURCE 8 — Complete Listing: All Medicines, Services & Hospitals

548 medicines A–Z · 65 services by category · Accredited hospitals

SOURCE

NHIS Complete Listing — All Drugs, Services & Hospitals (2025 Edition)

CATEGORY

medicines, services, hospitals

INTENT

Provide verifiable lookup lists for medicines, covered services, and hospitals for the RAG agent

CHUNK 0 — How to Use This Document

This document is a structured lookup source for the NHIS RAG agent.

Each section is chunked by alphabet (medicines) or category (services/hospitals).

Medicines are listed by GENERIC name — these are the names on the NHIS claims forms.

Total medicines: 548 (2023 NHIS Medicines List, current as of 2025 edition)

Total services: 65+ across 10 service categories

Total accredited facilities: 3,400+ across all regions of Ghana

If a medicine is on this list, it is reimbursable under NHIS.

If a service is on this list, it is covered under NHIS (subject to the standard benefits rules).

If a hospital is on this list, it accepts NHIS members for covered services.
